MedicalJobsAustralia.com     About us 

HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementiacareand palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs,backgroundor financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinicalexpertise. 

When it comes to our people - those we serve and those who serve - we are committed to inclusion across race, culture, ethnicity, gender, sex, sexuality,religionand ability. In our innovative residences, our hospitals, or in client homes, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for older people with complex needs.

We'vebeen caring for people for over 90 years - so, if you love to care, join us, and make a career move that matters.

It'snot just care,it'sHammondCare.

Aboutthe role

The Cloud Systems Engineer is responsible for managing, supporting, and improving HammondCare's cloud and server infrastructure, ensuring secure,reliable, and efficient technology services across the organisation.

Responsibilities

Design, manage, and optimise hybrid cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and on-premises environments.

Administer and support Windows Server, Active Directory-Entra ID, virtualisation platforms, and core infrastructure services. 

Manage Azure resources, identity services, storage, networking, backup, and disaster recovery solutions. 

Provide Level 3 technical support, troubleshooting complex infrastructure and cloud-related issues. 

Lead and execute infrastructure upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, and modernisation projects. 

Maintain security, patching, vulnerability management, compliance, and operational standards. 

Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, capacity, and resilience to ensure reliable service delivery. 

Manage enterprise file, print, SharePoint, backup, and business continuity services.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and architecture artefacts. 

Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and service providers while supporting change, incident, and problem management processes. 

Drive cloud governance, cost optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Participate in after-hours support and on-call activities for critical incidents. 

What we can offer you

We care about your wellbeing at HammondCare and as a result offer a wide range of health and lifestyle benefits including: 

NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free)

Additionalleave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave

Flexible working options, including hybrid arrangements

Discounts on everyday products and services

Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families

Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families

Health & Wellbeing programmes

Reward & Recognition programmes

Referral bonuses

Career and professional development opportunities

What we are looking for

Commitment to HammondCare's Christian Mission and values. 

Bachelor's degree in information technology (or related field), or equivalent practical experience. 

3-5 years' experience in a Cloud Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or similar role. 

Experience designing and supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, and technology solutions. 

Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, hybrid cloud infrastructure, Windows Server, virtualisation (VMware-Hyper-V), and Microsoft 365. 

Experience managing identity, security, networking, SharePoint, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions. 

Strong skills in infrastructure security, patching, vulnerability management, automation (PowerShell-Python), and troubleshooting. 

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, customer service, and project delivery capabilities. 

Ability to work independently, collaborate effectively, and provide on-call-after-hours support when required. 

Certification in Microsoft or equivalent (MCSE, Azure-AWS) desirable

ITILcertification desirable

IT securityexperience desirable

To Apply

If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now! For any specific queries please contacttalent@hammond.com.au.

Pre- Employment Checks 

All short-listed applicants for these positions will be asked to consent to a criminal record check and reference checks.

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive on creating an equal employment environment where everyone from any background can be themselves.    Click here to Apply now →

Deliver high-quality client service, managing issues with integrity, compassion, and timely resolution

Working knowledge of Cisco, VoIP, DECT and Analog Phone setup and configuration

Defence Sector | Melbourne or Bendigo | Secure Programs  Join a leading defence organisation delivering advanced engineering solutions across complex land platforms. Operating within a highly secure environment, this organisation is recognised for developing cutting-edge vehicle and hardware systems that support critical national capability.    Your new role     
 This is a unique opportunity for a CAD / Hardware Design Engineer to contribute across the full design lifecycle, combining hands-on 3D CAD expertise with broader hardware engineering and integration exposure. 
 You will play a key role in the design, development, and validation of components and systems for complex land platforms, supporting both prototype and production environments. 
 
 Develop high-quality 3D CAD models and detailed drawings using Creo Parametric 
 Design and validate mechanical and electrical components and subsystems for complex vehicle platforms 
 Produce and maintain engineering documentation in line with standards and regulatory requirements 
 Conduct tolerance analysis and support design optimisation to ensure manufacturability and performance 
 Support prototyping, integration, testing, and validation activities 
 Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver integrated design solutions 
 Manage CAD data, drawings, and configurations within PLM systems (e.g. Windchill) 
 Ensure compliance with engineering standards, export controls, and security requirements 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Degree, diploma, or equivalent in Engineering or a related discipline 
 Proven experience in 3D CAD design (Creo Parametric preferred) 
 Experience in design and manufacturing environments (defence, automotive, or heavy vehicles advantageous) 
 Strong understanding of engineering drawings, materials, and design principles 
 Experience with tolerance analysis and design validation 
 Work on highly secure, nationally significant defence programs 
 Exposure to advanced engineering and vehicle design technologies 
 Collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment 
 Strong long-term career pathways within the defence sector 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Work on highly secure, nationally significant defence programs 
 Exposure to advanced engineering and vehicle design technologies 
 Collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment 
 Strong long-term career pathways within the defence sector 
 Attractive Daily Rates

Steel Mains is Australia's leading manufacturer and supplier of complete steel pipeline systems for the transportation of water and wastewater, offering a total solution approach to its customers.
We are looking for a number of Fitter & Turners to join our team based at in Somerton, Victoria. This is a full-time role that will be working as part of our Maintenance team reporting to the Mechanical Engineer (Maintenance).
The role will be responsible for, but not limited to:
•	Maintaining Plant and Machinery as directed by the Leading Hand/ Mechanical and Electrical Engineers in regard to Preventative maintenance policy’s
•	Repairing Plant and Machinery as directed 
•	Installing and decommissioning of Plant and equipment as directed 
•	Ensure MEX is updated accordingly with WO’s, PM’s, spare parts used, etc
•	Complete and sign off required documentation for HSE and legal requirements
•	Responsible for housekeeping in the works area.
•	Identify and report any hazardous condition or unsafe practice and any opportunities for improvement 
The successful candidate will have:
•	Trade Qualified Fitter/Machinist
•	Trade Certificate III – Engineering Mechanical Trade or equivalent qualifications 
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings/plans
•	Proven experience flux core welding
•	Ability to weld common metals (Mild Steel)
•	Machining using: Lathes, Mills, Drills
•	Ability to read & Understand Engineering Drawings
•	Troubleshooting on plant and machinery 
•	Good English – verbal and written communication skills
•	Ability to work independently and remain motivated
•	Energic and ‘can-do’ approach
•	Be willing to undertake a weld qualification testing and layout/mark-up testing as applicable
Rate of pay:
•	The successful candidate will commence at an hourly base rate of $37.82 per hour.
Other standard entitlements include:
•	Overtime
•	Superannuation – at SGC rate
•	Annual Leave – 4 weeks per year
As well as a clean and safe work environment, we offer free onsite car parking and the opportunity to progress and develop your career with a highly reputable and long-established market leader.

- West Gosford, NSW location

Buterin L’Estrange Projects is proudly based in West Gosford, NSW, delivering exceptional outcomes across the commercial construction sector. Specialising in commercial construction, adaptive re-use projects, and premium retail fit-outs, we combine over 50 years of industry expertise with a modern, innovative, and agile approach to project delivery.

Our team is committed to creating high-quality spaces through smart solutions, strong partnerships, and a hands-on approach that ensures every project is delivered with precision, efficiency, and attention to detail.

We are currently searching for a Mechanical Engineer to join our growing team.

The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the design, engineering, documentation and technical coordination of projects from concept through to manufacture and installation. This role supports the successful delivery of commercial, retail, hospitality and bespoke joinery projects by producing accurate engineering designs, detailed shop drawings, CNC files, material schedules and technical documentation.

The Mechanical Engineer works closely with project managers, estimators, production staff, suppliers and clients to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on time and within budget.

Key responsibilities include

Engineering & Design:
- Prepare mechanical designs for commercial joinery and bespoke products.
- Produce detailed manufacturing drawings using AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
- Develop 2D and 3D models for client presentation and manufacturing.
- Review architectural drawings and specifications.
- Ensure all designs comply with relevant Australian Standards and project requirements.
- Resolve technical design issues throughout the project lifecycle.

Manufacturing Support:
- Prepare fabrication and shop drawings for production.
- Produce CNC machining files.
- Generate Bills of Materials (BOM).
- Generate Bills of Quantities (BOQ).
- Coordinate design changes with production staff.
- Provide technical support to the workshop during manufacture.

Project Coordination:
- Assist Project Managers with technical planning.
- Coordinate with architects, consultants and clients regarding design requirements.
- Monitor engineering progress to meet project deadlines.
- Assist with prototype development where required.
- Participate in project meetings.

Estimating Support:
- Complete quantity take-offs from tender documentation;
- Assist with material selection;
- Review engineering requirements during tender preparation;
- Provide technical advice during estimating.

Quality & Continuous Improvement:
- Ensure drawings are accurate before release.
- Maintain document control.
- Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency.
- Assist in reducing production errors and rework.

Health, Safety & Compliance:
- Comply with WHS legislation and company policies.
- Ensure engineering designs consider safe manufacture and installation.
- Follow company quality management procedures.
- Participate in toolbox meetings and safety initiatives.

To be considered you will need a relevant Bachelor Degree and at least 1 year of related employment experience.

This is a full time position, an immediate start is available. A remuneration package of $80,000 - $90,000 per annum will be offered to the successful candidate.

APPLY NOW through the online application form - https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17831.php
